description: Future value of an investment with monthly contributions and monthly compounding. Use when the user asks how savings or an investment grows over time with regular contributions. For a 401k with employer match use calculate_401k; for a retirement balance use calculate_retirement_savings_planner. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive compound interest calculator.
